source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Excel_Source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'LIS_DEL_RECORS_INBOUND' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DataLoad1125_') AS Excel_Source_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Excel_Source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'LIS_DEL_RECORS_INBOUND' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DataLoad1125_') AS Excel_Source_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Excel_Source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'LIS_DEL_RECORS_INBOUND' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DataLoad1125_') AS Excel_Source_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'LIS_DEL_RECORS_INBOUND' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DataLoad1125_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'LIS_DEL_RECORS_INBOUND' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'DataLoad1125_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_DataLoad1125__source_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'LIS_DEL_RECORS_INBOUND' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_DataLoad1125_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_DataLoad1125__source_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_DataLoad1125__source_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'LIS_DEL_RECORS_INBOUND' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_DataLoad1125_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_DataLoad1125__source_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_DataLoad1125__sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'LIS_DEL_RECORS_INBOUND' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_DataLoad1125_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_DataLoad1125__sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_DataLoad1125__sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'LIS_DEL_RECORS_INBOUND' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Destination_DataLoad1125_') AS OLE_DB_Destination_DataLoad1125__sink_TableName;
